definitions.speed: PedPy centered 0.4s displacement, descriptive only; not predictor input
definitions.density: PedPy classic count/physical polygon area; IMPTC uses declared convex hull of semantic corridor solely for dynamics analysis, GT boundaries unchanged
definitions.flow: PedPy unique first line crossings / recording duration; bidirectional; not repeated crossings
definitions.behavior: pseudo-label: stop<0.2m/s>=1s; decel<-0.3m/s²>=0.4s; turn>45deg over1s>=0.4s while both 1s displacements exceed0.3m; restart>0.3m/s after stop
definitions.inD_zone: camera footprint and vertical midline, NOT verified crosswalk exit
definitions.independence: recording/track IDs, not globally identified people; IMPTC gaps split into segments
definitions.split: descriptive analysis of all available recordings, no fitting or selection

limitations: SPD-to-IMPTC/inD covariance axis alignment and transfer are assumptions; target-only error, context treated as known.
Filter q=0.5 m²/s³ is fixed engineering assumption, not learned behavioral Q; no Test tuning.
Temporally correlated noise is synthetic AR(1)=0.8. Standard KF assumes white measurement noise, so correlated condition deliberately tests mismatch.
DD-MDN may already contain annotation noise; R+Q can double count it. Separate clean/noisy/filtered-mean/R+Q comparisons are diagnostic; physical identification is not established.
Public inD Test recordings share locations with Train; not leave-one-location-out or external generalization.
inD exit GT unavailable: no completion probabilities. All completion outputs remain Simulation-only.
Multiple windows of one event are dependent. Counts distinguish windows/events/recordings.

Release QA corrected the inD blocking-palette adapter to the official channel mapping. Deprecated pre-fix results are preserved in reports/release_qa_20261110/before; corrected metrics use exactly the same cases/settings.
Filter initialization and q_filter are fixed assumptions; they were not selected on Test. The official inD context raster physical scale is preserved for checkpoint compatibility, not recalibrated.
